title: GOAL: Jev Context Intelligence & Harness Economy program (P0 audit → P1 context telemetry baseline → shadow-first context router, tool disclosure, conditional instructions, handoff economics, action gating, read suppression, trust boundary, scorecards, promotion, evals)
spec: The user's brief is .orchestrator/roadmap-context.md (verbatim, 2026-09-22). Mission: minimize tokens, latency, model calls, retrieval and tool overhead per accepted goal without reducing accepted-goal quality, by removing irrelevant/repeated context, duplicated retrieval, unnecessary tool schemas and instructions, redundant handoffs and redundant reads. Jev is a bounded, optional, fail-open, shadow-first System-One layer under the existing agents and never overrides deterministic safety. This GOAL is the parent of every phase task; Planner checkpoint .orchestrator/plan.md. Order: P0 audit (read-only scouts) → P1 telemetry + baseline → P26 decision-log kinds + P23/24/25 modes → P2/P3/P4/P6 context router in shadow → P10/P12 disclosure and instructions in shadow → P17/P18 action gate and read suppression → P14-P16 handoff economics → P27-P29 scorecards → P21/P22 verification and P30 promotion → P31 evals. Every P2+ feature ships off/shadow first and is promoted only on scorecard evidence.
acceptance: P0 audit synthesized into plan.md and a docs/ architecture note with anchors: token entry points per role packet, repeated context, duplicated retrieval, always-exposed tool schemas, always-loaded instructions, handoff reconstruction
P1 context telemetry merged and a baseline recorded before any behaviour change
context router, tool disclosure and conditional instructions each ship with off/shadow/active modes and scorecards; promotion only on evidence
